default_lang.description: Display name for the server on the login screen and default language setting

host.description: Hostname or IP address for server. Use '' for UNIX domain socket.

sslmode.description: Database SSL mode. Possible options: disable, allow, prefer, require, legacy, unspecified

defaultdb.description: Change the default database only if you cannot connect to template1.

pg_dump_path.description: Specify the path to the pg_dump utility for this server.

pg_dumpall_path.description: Specify the path to the pg_dumpall utility for this server.

extra_session_security.description: If true, PHP's session cookies will have SameSite cookie flags set to prevent CSRF attacks.

extra_login_security.description: If true, logins via phpPgAdmin with no password or certain usernames will be denied.

min_password_length.description: Minimum length users can set their password to.

left_width.description: Width of the left frame in pixels (object browser)

theme.description: Which look & feel theme to use

max_rows.description: Max rows to show on a page when browsing record sets

max_chars.description: Max chars of each field to display by default in browse mode

ajax_refresh.description: Time in seconds for ajax refresh. If set to 0, refreshing data using ajax will be disabled.

plugins.description: Array of plugin names to activate.
